methodology: Reviewed capability/consumer inventory; statuses do not imply production effectiveness. Wired means a callable implementation; partial means scope or delivery gaps; missing means no end-to-end consumer; external requires independent evidence. Includes proposed market capabilities and deployment/assurance requirements. Historical module-reachability counts are not feature counts.

features.name: Tool artifact extraction
features.delivered: Commands, paths, URLs, package specs, content
features.remaining: Unrecognized or host-hidden actions remain outside visibility

features.name: Threat rules and confidence merge

features.remaining: Independent false-positive and evasion measurements remain required
